up10:2.1: While fulfilling the conditions for Awakening he was born as a kind of quail,
up10:2.2: and through his spiritual power the Great Being avoided the forest-fire.
up10:2.3: This was spoken by the Lord of the World to the Elder Sāriputta,
up10:2.4: it has great power for a world-cycle: we will recite that safeguard.
up10:4.1: There is in the world virtue, truth, purity and empathy,
up10:4.2: by the truth of that I will make an asseveration of supreme truth.
up10:5.1: After reflecting on the strength of the Dhamma, and recalling the former Victors,
up10:5.2: relying on the strength of truth, I made an asseveration of truth:
up10:6.1: “There are wings which fly not, there are feet which walk not,
up10:6.2: Mother and Father have gone out, Fire, please depart!”
up10:7.1: This (asseveration) was made by me with truth, and the great blazing fire
up10:7.2: avoided (this area for) sixteen measures, like fire after reaching water,
up10:7.3: there is no one my equal for truth, such is my perfection of truth!
up10:8.1: By this declaration of the truth may you be safe at all times!
